changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE TFPM_ADDR_ENRICH.STRUCTURING_RESULTS ( RESULT_ID NUMBER(19) GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, CORRELATION_ID VARCHAR2(64 CHAR) NOT NULL, SOURCE_CHANNEL VARCHAR2(16 CHAR) NOT NULL, RAW_ADDRESS VARCHAR2(2000 CHAR) NOT NULL, COUNTRY_HINT CHAR(2), FIELDS_JSON CLOB CONSTRAINT CK_FIELDS_JSON CHECK (FIELDS_JSON IS JSON), STRUCTURER_TRACE CLOB CONSTRAINT CK_TRACE_JSON CHECK (STRUCTURER_TRACE IS JSON), OVERALL_CONFIDENCE NUMBER(3,2) NOT NULL, REQUIRES_REVIEW CHAR(1) DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL CONSTRAINT CK_REVIEW CHECK (REQUIRES_REVIEW IN ('Y','N')), CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_RESULTS PRIMARY KEY (RESULT_ID), CONSTRAINT CK_RES_CONF CHECK (OVERALL_CONFIDENCE BETWEEN 0 AND 1), CONSTRAINT CK_RES_CHANNEL CHECK (SOURCE_CHANNEL IN ('HTTP','KAFKA','MQ')) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (CREATED_AT) INTERVAL (NUMTODSINTERVAL(7, 'DAY')) (PARTITION P_INITIAL VALUES LESS THAN (TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'));
